prompts.title: Boy Standing Next to 3D Name
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image only for the subject’s face and identity reference. 
Create a premium photorealistic full-body studio fashion portrait of the stylish man in a vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. Place the subject slightly left of center, large in frame, with very little empty space above the head and only a small amount of floor visible below.
Pose: both hands in jogger pockets, relaxed stance, one leg slightly crossed forward with one heel raised. Soft eye contact with confident expression.
Dress him in a deep burgundy / wine-maroon oversized co-ord set: a loose oversized sweatshirt and relaxed joggers with heavy cotton texture, soft drape, and rich folds. Sleeves should be scrunched to the forearms. Include visible jogger drawstrings, clean white low-top sneakers, and a subtle smartwatch.
On the right side, place huge freestanding sculptural 3D block Capital letters spelling “Rock,” arranged vertically with one letter stacked above the next, forming a bold design column close to the subject. The letters should feel like heavy architectural objects and may have slight rotation or tilt for a more natural stacked installation look, but must remain clearly readable. Use bright silver-white front faces, darker gray side faces, crisp edges, deep extrusion, and a premium matte-satin finish.
Use a dark charcoal-gray seamless studio background with a soft matte gray floor. The backdrop must look fully seamless, with no visible corners or room edges. Both the subject and the 3D letters should appear placed close to the background wall, with visible soft shadows falling behind them, especially behind the text. Add only a very subtle floor reflection.
Use bright, clean, premium studio lighting with soft frontal light and a gentle upper-left key light. Keep the outfit color rich and vibrant, the face and outfit crisp, and the letters cleanly highlighted. Avoid dull tones, blue cast, heavy glow, or overly dark cinematic lighting. The final look should feel sharp, modern, polished, luxurious, and editorial.

prompts.title: Framed Reality
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image only for the woman’s facial identity and natural features. Create a polished 3D cartoon-style social media influencer portrait in a 4:5 vertical composition.
Show the woman emerging realistically from a large, tilted Instagram-style post frame held from the lower-left corner by a realistic human hand. The oversized white social-media frame should include a clean Instagram-style header, photo window, like/comment/share icons, carousel dots, caption area, and bottom navigation icons. Keep the interface elegant and readable, but do not add any creator watermark, badge, name, or text in the outer top-left or top-right corners.
Inside the frame, place the woman in a cheerful, confident pose with a warm open smile. She has long, voluminous softly wavy hair flowing naturally to one side, expressive eyes, soft rosy cheeks, and refined animated facial details while retaining her recognizable identity. She wears a cropped blue denim jacket over a fitted white ribbed top, layered gold necklaces, high-waisted beige paperbag trousers with a tied belt, and clean pastel pink-and-white sneakers.
Pose is important: show her in a relaxed seated pose on the lower edge of the social-media frame, not standing or kneeling. Her hips rest naturally on the bottom border of the frame. One hand is placed down on the lower-left edge of the frame for support, while the other arm extends outward to the side holding a smartphone. One leg is bent comfortably inward over the lower part of the frame, while the other leg stretches outward and downward beyond the frame toward the viewer, creating a casual crossed-out seated look. Both legs should feel relaxed and playful, with the front sneaker prominently visible in perspective.
Create a strong 3D pop-out illusion: her seated body remains partly inside the frame while her bent leg, extended leg, sneaker, and phone-holding arm project outside the frame toward the viewer. The pose should clearly feel like she is sitting in and stepping out of the frame at the same time, matching a playful influencer-style pop-out composition. Use realistic hand anatomy, clean clothing folds, soft materials, detailed sneaker soles, and premium toy-like 3D rendering.
Use soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, a subtle blurred gray-blue background, shallow depth of field, smooth high-end CGI textures, and a playful modern influencer aesthetic. Keep the post frame large and dominant in the composition, with the woman centered and clearly breaking out of it.

prompts.title: Man in Shades
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic black-and-white editorial poster portrait of a reference male subject in a 4:5 vertical aspect ratio. Use the uploaded image strictly only for face and identity reference.
The composition is a tight chest-up portrait, with the subject centered in the frame. He is posed in a confident 3/4 side profile, facing slightly toward the left, not looking at the camera. His expression is calm, stylish, and self-assured.
The subject wears thin metal-frame round sunglasses with dark lenses, a dark denim jacket, and a plain white crew-neck T-shirt underneath. Keep the styling clean, masculine, and modern.
Use dramatic high-contrast studio lighting with a crisp editorial look. The lighting should create sharp highlights and defined shadows across the face, hair, jawline, neck, jacket, and glasses, giving the portrait a bold cinematic depth. prompts.title: The Creative Lead
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-high-detail 3D animated character portrait in a premium Disney/Pixar-inspired style, designed to feel highly appealing, expressive, and avatar-friendly.

Composition:
Medium portrait (waist-up), centered, slightly body turned one side, eye-level camera angle. Subject fills ~65–75% of the frame.

Subject:
Stylized male character with slightly chibi-influenced proportions — subtly larger head (~10–15% larger than realistic proportion) and a slightly compact, youthful body while still maintaining an adult identity. Clean facial structure, smooth but detailed skin, highly expressive large eyes (not cartoonishly oversized).

Hair & Accessories:
Neatly styled, soft-volume hair with visible strand detail. Thick matte grey rim glasses, well-fitted and premium-looking.

Outfit:
Matte black long-sleeve button-down shirt with collar and two chest pockets. Sleeves rolled to mid-forearms.
Fabric must feel premium and realistic — visible micro-texture, stitching, natural folds, soft cloth behavior, subtle specular highlights (no plastic look).

Pose (IMPORTANT):
Arms confidently crossed. Body slightly angled (~15° right) to avoid flatness. Head turned toward camera with strong, natural posture.

Expression:
Highly joyful, warm, and engaging smile — friendly and likable (avatar appeal focus), not exaggerated to the point of distortion. Eyes lively with strong emotional presence.

Background:
Pure white seamless studio background (#FFFFFF), completely clean and minimal.

Behind the subject, add a large round shape in a rich yellow color gradient. The shape must be centered behind the subject’s head and upper torso, occupying ~50–70% of the background width.
Smooth edges, flat matte finish, no texture
Creating a strong contrast with the black outfit and helping the subject stand out visually.

No shadows cast on the white background, only a faint soft separation shadow between subject and shape if needed.
Lighting:
Soft high-key studio lighting. Even facial illumination with gentle shadow depth.
Subtle rim light on the left side of the hair and the shoulder for separation. Bright, crisp eye catchlights.

Rendering & Quality:
8K ultra-detailed render, Unreal Engine 5/Octane quality.
PBR materials, subsurface scattering for natural skin glow, high-resolution textures, sharp focus, clean premium color grading.
Stylized realism — no AI artifacts, no over-smoothing, no plastic skin.

Aspect Ratio: 4:5
